title: Prevention of Spillage on Roads by Trucks Carrying Sand
what_it_is: Prevention of Spillage on Roads by Trucks Carrying Sand

sections.label: Sand transport enforcement and fines
sections.summary: NEA took over 450 enforcement actions from 2016 to 2018 against drivers transporting sand without proper cover, with fines up to $1,000 or $2,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: From 2016 to 2018, NEA took more than 450 enforcement actions against drivers for transporting sand and other materials without proper cover.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Under the Environmental Public Heath (Public Cleansing) Regulations, persons conveying sand or other similar materials along a public road by vehicle without adequate cover face fines of up to $1,000 upon conviction for a first offence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Additionally, under the Environmental Public Health Act, persons who drop or spill the same on a public road would also be liable for fines of up to $2,000 upon conviction for a first offence.

sections.label: Portable cameras detect spillage
sections.summary: NEA uses portable surveillance cameras at hotspots to detect and identify vehicles spilling sand or other materials on public roads.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: NEA employs portable surveillance cameras to detect vehicles that spill sand or other materials on public roads.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: They deploy such devices at hotspots to spot and identify errant vehicles and their drivers for further investigation and enforcement.

sections.label: Exceeding maximum laden weight penalties
sections.summary: Offenders caught with trucks or lorries exceeding the maximum laden weight limit can be fined up to $1,000, jailed up to three months, or both.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Offenders who are caught with their trucks or lorries exceeding the maximum laden weight limit can be fined up to $1,000 upon conviction, jailed for up to three months or both.

sections.label: Camera hotspots and spillage feedback
sections.summary: Portable cameras are installed at hotspots like construction sites and concrete batching plants, and over 300 spillage feedback cases were received from 2016 to 2018, declining.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Very often, our portable cameras are installed at hotspots where we have received quite a number of feedback cases and tip-offs about such spillage, for instance, near large construction sites or concrete batching plants where these vehicles often ply, in order to enforce against such vehicles and the drivers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I just wish to make a note that between 2016 and 2018, we received more than 300 instances of feedback on spillage on the roads from such trucks and lorries, and these numbers have been declining.

sections.label: Drivers must cover building materials
sections.summary: Drivers are responsible for ensuring flap covers properly cover building materials before driving off the site.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The drivers are responsible for ensuring that the flap covers properly cover the building materials before they drive off the site.
